text:
lina: FYI: after the midnight OOB push (02:28Z) a few eu-central racks started showing NVMe resets and transient GPU evictions. Pods bounced and tail latency increased.

marco: Seen it on the cluster dashboard  ~9 GPUs across r33-07/r33-09/r33-10 drained, scheduler moved jobs to best-effort.

sre-robin: Quick grep of the logs shows PCIe retrain messages during BMC activation and a couple BMCs reporting an RTC jump. Looks like the image activation path flips secure-boot enforcement on some boards which forces a re-enumeration. That re-enumeration is triggering lane retrain on older NIC/slot combos.

infra-oncall: Pausing the rest of the rollout to eu regions.

deploy-bot: rollout "oob-bmc-2026-03-21" status: PAUSED by infra-oncall at 02:48Z.

ops-ethan: Starting targeted revert on r33-07 now. Commands I'm running:
```
ssh jump-rack-ops
sudo bmcctl flash --image s3://firmware/bmc-2026-02-04-signed.bin --rack r33-07 --force-reboot
sudo bmcctl ntp-sync --rack r33-07
sleep 30 && bmc-health --rack r33-07 | egrep "AER|nvme|pci"
```

devops-ankita: Strong rec: add a preflight gate to the deploy pipeline that checks BMC NTP (<1s), NVMe AER counters, and zero PCIe retrains in the last 24h for the rack. Also capture PCIe slot telemetry during canary.

finance-liz: Cost note: if we hold canaries and pause autoscaler for 12-24h this will add ~60-100 GPU-hours in eu-central. I've pinged budget owners.

sre-robin: Short-term mitigations: bump kubelet eviction grace to 10m for affected nodepools, and disable scale-in for eu-central inference pools to avoid cascading reschedules. Also enable verbose PCIe/AER counters collection for the next 2 canaries.

lina: After revert, run 20m fio on local NVMe and a 15m GPU burn to validate retention. If green, resume with a single-rack canary and 45m observation window.

infra-oncall: I'll post an incident update to #incidents in 20m with customer impact. Postmortem owners: marco + devops-ankita. Keep updates short. :thumbsup:
